title: Changed the tutorial to one that you don't have to read and cleaned most of UI | Lumen Ledger
author: Need300dollars
selftext:
[https://goodboycat.itch.io/lumen-ledger](https://goodboycat.itch.io/lumen-ledger)

Now no more "too much UI" and people that loves to skip reading can do it. This idea came by playing others mobile game (from my other post). 

All this updates where done by Sonnet 5.5. It even fixed frame by frame the sword attacks, something that fable 5.1 couldn't do.

If I where to make a dev team I would say everyone use Sonnet 5.5, seriously, cheap and good is enough.

But I have to admit, while the game hooks, at the end, is fine, not great nor disappointing, just fine, which is why I decided to publish it as it is, also because without other opinions I can't see the flaws.

Support AI Game Devs and give me a review! It's free!
